headline: Boeing Shares Fall as 737 Max Shortfalls Pressure Delivery Outlook
summary: Boeing shares sold off after the company announced it would fall short on 737 Max deliveries, weighing on its turnaround plans and free cash flow outlook.
why: Commercial aircraft production rates are a key driver of cash flow and operational recovery for aerospace manufacturers.

impacts.name: Boeing Co
impacts.why: Slower-than-expected 737 production targets and weaker free cash flow forecasts directly impair investor sentiment and valuation.

why_moved: Lower-than-expected aircraft delivery figures and delayed production schedules directly threaten near-term cash flow generation.
